caption: Half of the Monte Brisas Outlaws, and one of the three men who dragged C.R. out of the wreckage of a table at New Era to hold him up for a splash.

identity.note: A common ring name. Registered separately from the Draven-named characters already on file (draven-dwo, derek-draven-gw); no evidence connects them.

The exact bare name "Raven" this hobby's most reused gimmick name, carried by an EUWC original character (euwc-raven) and by five other feds' own portrayals of the real wrestler Raven (raven-faw, raven-icwc, raven-uwf-uwow, raven-uwow, raven-xwf-uwow, none of which carry a portrayal_of edge on this row — this XWF character is not asserted to be a portrayal of anyone). Reciprocal guard: each of those rows already lists raven-xwf in its own identity[]; this closes the gap on this side. Per the per-promotion portrayal rule and the real-wrestler portrayal rule, a real wrestler's portrayal is always a per-promotion row, never merged across promotions, and the external-figures row is the only node any of them may share; nothing held connects this XWF character to any of them beyond the shared name.
